def do_POST(self):
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(self.path)
        if parsed.path.startswith("/telegram-webhook/"):
            length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0") or "0")
            if length > 16384:
                self._send(HTTPStatus.REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE, "REQUEST_TOO_LARGE\n")
                return
            body = self.rfile.read(length)
            status, payload = self.server.telegram_canary.handle_webhook(
                parsed.path,
                self.headers.get("X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token", ""),
                body,
            )
            self._send(status, json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True) + "\n", content_type="application/json; charset=utf-8")
            return
        if parsed.path == TIKTOK_DISCONNECT_PATH:
            payload = TikTokTokenLifecycleStore(DEFAULT_STATE_ROOT / "tiktok-token-state").disconnect()
            self.server.portal_service.operations_store.record_audit({
                "operation": "TIKTOK_DISCONNECT",
                "provider": "tiktok",
                "result": "PASS",
                "secret_value_exposed": False,
            })
            self._send(HTTPStatus.OK, json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True) + "\n", content_type="application/json; charset=utf-8")
            return
